Name: Crowded Tree Grow
Author: 1A2B3C4DABCD
Description:
[size=4][b]Description[/b][/size]
Crowded Trees Grow removes clearance limits for tree growth and planting.
Wild trees keep growing past stage 4 even when a mature tree is adjacent.
Fruit trees can grow without a clear 3×3 area, and can be planted next to other trees, objects, or paths.

You can customize the settings via the Generic Mod Config Menu or by editing the `config.json` file in the `MoreTreeSeeds` folder.
[list]
[*][b]Grow next to mature trees[/b]: Wild trees keep growing past stage 4 even when a mature tree is adjacent.[/*]
[*][b]Grow without clearance[/b]: Fruit trees grow even if the surrounding 8 tiles are occupied. Also needed to plant next to objects/paths.[/*]
[*][b]Plant without tree clearance[/b]: Allow planting saplings next to other trees(skips the 2-tile distance check).[/*]
[/list]
[size=4][b]Installation instructions[/b][/size]
Unzip the file and put the  [b]CrowdedTreesGrow[/b] folder inside the [b]Stardew Valley\Mods[/b] folder.
Requires SMAPI 4.0+
